Safi | Product Engineer | London HQ or Remote (within ±2 hrs of London) | Full-time | £110,000–£160,000 + equity | https://www.safi.co

We're hiring for a Senior/Staff level Product Engineer to help us get as close to our customers as possible and develop product with them.

You will be helping Forklift Drivers and Plant Managers at industrial recyclers (smelters, MRFs, plastics) use ML Models via their phones to assess the quality of material in their yard, and exploring how we can enter in to other markets too.

If you're excited to join a small, eager, talented team please get in touch!

Apply: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/safi/06794918-bef7-4a6b-a2d3-c58c17...
